card.text: A galaxy seen 290 million years after the Big Bang, its distance measured by both Webb and ALMA.

sources.label: Schouws et al. (2025), Detection of [OIII] 88 µm in JADES-GS-z14-0 at z = 14.1793, ApJ (accepted), arXiv:2409.20549
sources.locator: abstract: detection of the [O III] 88 µm line with ALMA at z = 14.1793, confirming the NIRSpec redshift

introduction.text: Webb's near-infrared view: the orange light is the galaxy, the pale one beside it a nearer galaxy. The picture is flat and has no depth.
